flashcard_questions.q: What is meant by development in geography?
flashcard_questions.a: The progress a country makes towards improving its people's quality of life.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the GNI per capita threshold for a high income country?
What is the GNI per capita threshold for a low income country?
Which employment sector dominates in low income countries?
flashcard_questions.a: Primary industry such as farming and mining.

flashcard_questions.q: What did the Brandt Line separate when it was drawn in the 1980s?
flashcard_questions.a: A rich north from a poor south.

flashcard_questions.q: Why is the Brandt Line now seen as outdated?
flashcard_questions.a: Many southern countries have grown into newly emerging economies.

flashcard_questions.q: How is the infant mortality rate measured?
flashcard_questions.a: Babies who die before their first birthday per 1,000 live births.

flashcard_questions.q: The Human Development Index combines life expectancy, years in education and ____.
What scale is used for a Human Development Index score?
Why can GNI per capita give a misleading picture of a country's development?
flashcard_questions.a: It is a mean average, so great wealth at the top hides widespread poverty.

flashcard_questions.q: What literacy rate does Cuba have despite its low GDP?
Which stage of the Demographic Transition Model has death rates above birth rates?
Why do birth rates fall during stage 3 of the Demographic Transition Model?
flashcard_questions.a: Education improves and women gain rights, so families choose to have fewer children.

flashcard_questions.q: Which types of job dominate in stages 4 and 5 of the Demographic Transition Model?

notes: 14 cards: 3 term-to-definition (development, infant mortality, HDI scale), 4 case-study-to-fact with one figure each (HIC threshold, LIC threshold, Cuba literacy, DTM stage 5), 3 cause-to-consequence (Brandt Line outdated, GNI mean skew, stage 3 birth rates), 1 cloze on the HDI components, 3 process-to-stage cards. Dropped the England life-expectancy split and the Maldives comparison as second examples that would interfere with the Cuba card.
